enriched_description: Freshwater mustelid measuring 60-120 cm body length weighing 5-15 kg. Body elongated and streamlined with short legs. Fur dense, dark brown, and waterproof with lighter ventral coloration. Head broad and flattened with short snout. Eyes small and dark. Ears small with valvular closure. Whiskers (vibrissae) prominent. Feet webbed with sharp claws. Tail long, thick, and muscular tapering to point. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, dense waterproof fur, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Semiaquatic carnivore with excellent swimming ability.

Musteline mammal measuring 40-70 cm body length weighing 1-5 kg. Body stocky with short legs. Fur black with distinctive white stripes or spots forming bold warning pattern. Head small with pointed snout. Eyes small and dark. Ears short. Tail long and bushy. Anal glands produce intensely malodorous fluid ejected as spray when startled, accurate to 3 m range. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Nocturnal omnivore. Warning coloration aposematic.

Sturdy mustelid measuring 55-90 cm body length weighing 7-17 kg. Body low-slung and robust with short powerful legs. Fur coarse in gray-brown dorsally with distinctive black and white facial stripes. Head broad and flattened with pointed snout. Eyes small. Ears small and rounded. Feet broad with long non-retractile claws adapted for digging. Tail short and bushy. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Burrowing carnivore with strong jaws and teeth for crushing prey.

Edentate mammal measuring 35-75 cm body length weighing 2-30 kg. Body covered with strong horny plates (osteoderms) forming protective armor over leathery skin. Coloration brownish-gray. Head small with pointed snout and conical teeth. Eyes small. Ears large and elongate. Legs short with powerful claws for digging. Tail armored with bony rings. Some species can roll into ball. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Nocturnal burrowing insectivore with poor vision but excellent olfaction.

Edentate mammal measuring 45-65 cm body length weighing 3.5-5 kg. Body covered with long coarse fur in gray-brown with greenish tint from symbiotic algae. Head small and rounded with short snout. Eyes small with dark facial markings. Ears inconspicuous. Forefeet with three long curved claws for hanging from branches. Hind feet also three-clawed. Tail vestigial. Body dorsoventrally flattened. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy (poorly regulated), fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Arboreal with extremely slow metabolism and movement.

Large great ape measuring 120-150 cm standing height weighing 35-90 kg. Body covered with long shaggy reddish-brown fur. Face broad and flat with prominent cheek pads in mature males. Eyes dark brown with forward-facing binocular vision. Ears small. Arms extremely long (wingspan 2 m) adapted for brachiation. Hands long-fingered with opposable thumbs and big toes. Body barrel-chested. No tail. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Arboreal habits of Borneo and Sumatra forests.

Largest anthropoid ape measuring 150-180 cm standing height weighing 100-200 kg. Body massive with sparse black fur. Mature males develop silver saddle of gray hair on back. Head large with prominent sagittal crest in males. Face black with small eyes and broad nose. Ears small. Arms longer than legs with broad hands. Chest broad and barrel-shaped. No tail. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Terrestrial and vegetarian of central west African forests. Knuckle-walking locomotion.

Anthropoid ape measuring 70-100 cm standing height weighing 30-60 kg. Body covered with sparse black or brown fur with bare face, ears, hands, and feet. Face light to dark with prominent ears. Eyes forward-facing with brown irises. Nose flat. Arms longer than legs with long fingers. Hands with opposable thumbs. Body slender compared to gorilla. No tail. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Intelligent arboreal ape of equatorial African forests. Tool-using capability.

Smallest anthropoid ape measuring 60-90 cm standing height weighing 4-10 kg. Body covered with dense fur in black, brown, white, or buff coloration. Arms exceptionally long (nearly twice body length) adapted for brachiation. Hands long-fingered with hook-like grip. Body slender and lightweight. Face bare and dark with prominent brow ridges. No tail. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Most perfectly anthropoid arboreal ape of southern Asia and East Indies. Nocturnal vocalizations.

Large black gibbon measuring 80-100 cm standing height weighing 10-14 kg. Body covered with long shaggy black fur. Face bare and black with prominent throat sac (gular sac) used for vocalization. Arms extremely long adapted for brachiation. Hands long-fingered. Second and third toes partially united by web (syndactyly). Body larger than other gibbons. No tail. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Largest gibbon species of Sumatra. Loud resonant calls from throat sac.
